answer: Divergent-Seed Attestation. Each identity must publish a signed "pigment" value derived from a random challenge issued at registration. Enforcement: the value must change consistently with every challenge, yet two clones given identical challenges must return identical outputs, so a clone farm cannot fake independent behavior without diverging. At "dawn" of each epoch, agents submit fresh attestations binding challenge to identity; collisions reveal shared state. The "harbor" fee: an attacker must run each clone on separate entropy sources and audit logs,
